lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Review round 1 filed 3 fix stories against the commit-existence gate epic (CAM-187) after US-001/002/003 were reviewed. This story (US-R1-001, priority 1) fixed the CRITICAL finding at src/supervisor/result.ts:300: commitSubjectMatchesStory only matched the bracketless form ('feat: US-001 - Title') but every real commit on this branch is bracketed ('feat: [US-001] - Title', scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md step 8). Fix: widened the anchored regex to `^feat:\s*(?:\[${id}\]|${id})\s*-\s*\S` (alternation, not `\[?...\]?`, to reject mismatched single brackets) so BOTH the bracketed convention and the older bracketless history match. Added 3 regression tests (bracketed match, mismatched-bracket rejection, bracketed-longer-id-prefix rejection) to test/supervisor/result.test.ts. Raised file-size ratchet ceilings for both files (result.ts 551->560, result.test.ts 1284->1296) with a tracker-ref in scripts/file-size-budget.json._ref. Two fix stories remain, both about the SAME epic and closely related: US-R1-002 (priority 2, CRITICAL, src/supervisor/host.ts:626) -- commitExistsForStory runs `git log --format=%s <branch>` which walks the FULL branch ancestry to root, so ancient bracketless commits from unrelated past PRDs (story ids are reused every PRD) collide and make the gate return true unconditionally, defeating the whole point of CAM-187. Fix should scope the git log to commits unique to THIS PRD/branch, e.g. `git log --format=%s main..HEAD` or `origin/main..HEAD` (the story's own notes field suggests this). US-R1-003 (priority 3, WARNING, test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1283 pre-fix line number) wants an integration test running the REAL host.ts adapter (not the injected fake used by loop.test.ts/host tests) against a repo whose only matching commit is bracketed -- this should exercise the fix from BOTH US-R1-001 (my fix, matcher) and US-R1-002 (the next story's fix, git log scoping) together, so it likely makes most sense to implement it after US-R1-002. Read the story's own `notes` field (there is no acceptanceCriteria array on these three fix stories, only notes -- judgment must be applied against the reviewer's literal finding text).
